description: This file defines an abstract class 'Connection' that provides core database connection functionalities for Drupal, including query preparation, execution, transaction management, and schema handling. It serves as a base for specific database driver implementations.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Abstract class providing core database connection functionalities for Drupal, including query handling, transaction management, schema access, and connection info management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Connection object with a client connection and options, setting up prefix and namespace.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Abstract method to open a client connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures the client connection object can be garbage collected.

methods.name: commitAll
methods.description: Commits all open transactions, working around Drupal's reliance on object destruction order.

methods.name: getClientConnection
methods.description: Returns the underlying client connection object (e.g., PDO).

methods.name: defaultOptions
methods.description: Provides default query options such as fetch mode and delimiters.

methods.name: getConnectionOptions
methods.description: Returns the connection configuration options.

methods.name: attachDatabase
methods.description: Allows attaching additional databases or schemas; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the table prefix used in queries.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the table prefix and updates placeholder replacements.

methods.name: prefixTables
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in SQL with the table prefix.

methods.name: quoteIdentifiers
methods.description: Quotes SQL identifiers (e.g., table or column names) with platform-specific characters.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedTableName
methods.description: Returns a fully qualified table name including database and prefix.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement with caching and placeholder processing.

methods.name: preprocessStatement
methods.description: Processes SQL to replace placeholders and ensure safety before preparation.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the target string for logging/auditing; only if not already set.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the target string.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets a unique key for the connection.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the connection key.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Associates a logging object with the connection.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the current logger object.

methods.name: makeComment
methods.description: Creates a sanitized SQL comment string from an array of comments.

methods.name: filterComment
methods.description: Sanitizes comment strings to prevent SQL injection.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with arguments, returning a statement or null.

methods.name: expandArguments
methods.description: Expands array placeholders in SQL queries into multiple placeholders.

methods.name: getDriverClass
methods.description: Returns driver-specific class overrides for database operations.

methods.name: exceptionHandler
methods.description: Returns a new ExceptionHandler instance.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Creates a new SELECT query object.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates a new INSERT query object.

methods.name: lastInsertId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID or sequence value.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Creates a new MERGE query object.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Abstract method to create an UPSERT query, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates a new UPDATE query object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates a new DELETE query object.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Creates a new TRUNCATE query object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Abstract method to get schema object, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Creates a new condition object for query constraints.

methods.name: escapeDatabase
methods.description: Sanitizes database name strings.

methods.name: escapeTable
methods.description: Sanitizes table name strings.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Sanitizes field name strings, handling dot notation.

methods.name: escapeAlias
methods.description: Sanitizes alias name strings.

methods.name: escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes wildcard characters in LIKE patterns.

methods.name: transactionManager
methods.description: Returns the transaction manager, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: driverTransactionManager
methods.description: Creates a driver-specific transaction manager; default throws exception.

methods.name: inTransaction
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is active.

methods.name: startTransaction
methods.description: Begins a new transaction or savepoint.

methods.name: queryRange
methods.description: Abstract method for limited-range queries, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Abstract method to get the driver type.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the database server version.

methods.name: clientVersion
methods.description: Returns the database client version.

methods.name: supportsTransactionalDDL
methods.description: Indicates if transactional DDL is supported.

methods.name: databaseType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the database engine name.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: mapConditionOperator
methods.description: Abstract method for special condition operator handling.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe SQL inclusion.

methods.name: getSQLState
methods.description: Extracts SQLSTATE error code from exceptions.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prevents serialization of the connection object.

methods.name: createConnectionOptionsFromUrl
methods.description: Parses a database URL into connection options.

methods.name: createUrlFromConnectionOptions
methods.description: Builds a database URL from connection options.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the module name providing the database driver.

methods.name: getPagerManager
methods.description: Retrieves the pager manager service.

methods.name: hasJson
methods.description: Checks if JSON datatype is supported.

methods.name: isEventEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a database event is enabled.

methods.name: enableEvents
methods.description: Enables specified database API events.

methods.name: disableEvents
methods.description: Disables specified database API events.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a database event via the event dispatcher.

methods.name: findCallerFromDebugBacktrace
methods.description: Finds the caller that invoked the database API, excluding internal calls.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntriesFromDebugBacktrace
methods.description: Removes database-related calls from a backtrace.

methods.name: getDebugBacktrace
methods.description: Returns the current debug backtrace, allowing for mocking in tests.
